headline: Automattic CEO Matt Mullenweg reportedly placed on leave
summary: WordPress.com owner Automattic's CEO, Matt Mullenweg, is reportedly on paid leave. Mullenweg claims the CFO conspired with board members to remove him. The internal announcement was viewed by 404 Media.

headline: It’s the year of smartphone price hikes
summary: New iPhone 18 Pro models see a $100 price increase, starting at $1,199. Older iPhone models also had their prices raised. Increased smartphone costs appear unavoidable this year across the board.

headline: Suno releases its first AI music model made with record industry help
summary: Suno launched its v6 AI music model, developed with record industry support. The model was trained on new, licensed data, separate from previous versions. This marks a significant step in collaboration between AI music and the industry.

headline: OpenAI’s sly mathematical breakthrough sends a chill through academia
summary: OpenAI claims to have solved a legendary Millennium Prize math problem. The announcement showcases AI's rapid impact on mathematics. The unusual circumstances surrounding the breakthrough have caused academic unease.

headline: Michael Mann Recuts Miami Vice for October Beyond Fest World Premiere
summary: Director Michael Mann has re-edited his 2006 film, Miami Vice. The new "Director's Final Cut" will premiere at Beyond Fest. The world premiere is scheduled for October 3, 2026, in Los Angeles.

headline: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy's Surprise Switch 2 Port Has Some Fans Hoping for a Sequel
summary: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy is getting a surprise Switch 2 port. The port comes five years after the game's initial release. Fans are now speculating and hoping for a potential sequel.

headline: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Is Getting an Official Prequel Webtoon With New Chapters Every Saturday
summary: Onimusha: Way of the Sword will receive an official prequel webtoon. New chapters will be released weekly, every Saturday. This expands the Onimusha universe beyond games.

headline: How Many Guest Characters Is Too Many? Tokyo Revengers X City of the Wolves Collaboration Sparks Fighting Game Debate
summary: A collaboration between Tokyo Revengers and City of the Wolves sparked debate. The fighting game community is discussing the number of guest characters. The debate centers on balancing original rosters with crossover content.

headline: Police launch criminal investigation into Reform UK donations
summary: Police have initiated a criminal investigation into Reform UK's donations. The inquiry follows a broadcast by Channel 4 News. It's being integrated into an existing investigation on other donations.

headline: Air traffic failure was avoidable, says transport secretary
summary: The transport secretary states the recent air traffic failure was avoidable. Heidi Alexander has ordered an investigation into the glitch. The failure led to over 2,000 flight cancellations.

headline: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
summary: Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to a planned mass migrant crossing. Warnings were issued via social media the day before the surge in Ceuta. Declassified documents confirm the intelligence reports.

headline: Muted US response to UK's West Bank sanctions may reflect simmering frustration
summary: The US has had a quiet reaction to the UK's West Bank sanctions. The UK accuses Israel of tolerating "ethnic cleansing" by settlers. The muted response could indicate growing US frustration.
